title: Action noise — default vs cranked
desc: TCP-space noise proportional to the commanded delta, added to every control step; the dataset stores the CLEAN commands (DART-style recovery supervision). Same seed, two noise levels — deviation stays bounded (jitter, not drift).
metrics: default: scale=0.1 pos_cap=2cm rot_cap=0.1 · 440 steps · TCP dev mean 6.1 mm / p99 39.8 mm / max 58.5 mm  |  cranked: scale=1.0 pos_cap=5cm rot_cap=0.3 · 439 steps · TCP dev mean 20.9 mm / p99 254.4 mm / max 297.5 mm
